title: Bug in live version

---

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**To Reproduce**
- How did you load the file?
- Which visualization had the error?

**Expected behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

**Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

**Additional context**
If you are having problems loading a file, please attach it to this issue (or a link to it). Remove anything you do not want to share publicly first.

Note that qvis-react only supports the latest qlog drafts (draft-ietf-quic-qlog-main-schema-14, quic-events-13 and h3-events-13; `.qlog` JSON or `.sqlog` JSON-SEQ). Please mention which browser and version you used; qvis-react is tested on the latest stable Google Chrome.
